trace.final:
Done. Summary:

1. **Investigated** — `checkout-api` v2.3.1 (the latest deploy) was unhealthy in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. The most recent release that had been healthy in production was **v2.3.0**.
2. **Rolled back** all regions to v2.3.0. Verified the service is now **healthy** with an error rate of ~0.2%.
3. **Opened SEV2 incident** INC-0001 (on-call paged) documenting the failed v2.3.1 deploy, the rollback to v2.3.0, and the need to root-cause and fix v2.3.1 before redeploying.

Note: v2.3.1 was previously deployed (to production) and unhealthy — per policy, redeploying an unhealthy version would need change-manager approval before any rollback of the rollback.
